summary: In Star Trek Online, the Star Trek universe appears for the first time on a truly massive scale.

requirements.minimum:
Minimum
OS: Windows® 10/11 (64-bit)
Processor: Core 2 Duo 2.2Ghz (or equivalent AMD CPU)
Memory: 4GB RAM
Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 4xx, ATI/AMD Radeon HD 5xxx, or Intel HD Graphics 4xxx (Direct3D Hardware Feature Level 11)
DirectX: Version 11.0
Network: Broadband Internet Connection
Storage: 21GB
Audio: DirectX 11 compatible sound chip or onboard audio capability with the latest sound drivers

Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 9xx or AMD Radeon RX 4xx or better

Network: Broadband Internet Connection
Storage: 21GB
Audio: DirectX 11 compatible sound chip or onboard audio capability with the latest sound drivers
